chunks: And in the narration of Zurārah from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
"If there is between her and him a distance equal to what may be stepped over, or equal to the measure of a forearm bone or more, then there is no harm if she prays beside him alone."

key_terms.بِحِذَائِهِ: beside him; parallel to him in position
key_terms.زُرَارَةَ: Zurārah, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection
key_terms.يُتَخَطَّى: that which can be stepped across

ai.seo_question: How much distance should be between a man and a woman praying side by side for it to be permissible?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about the permissibility of a woman praying beside a man when a certain distance separates them. It indicates that if there is a sufficient gap between them, then there is no objection to her praying alongside him.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.747 - In the narration of Zurarah from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), said:
"If there is a distance between her and him that is about the length of a step or about the length of a cubit or more, then there is no harm if She prays beside him alone."
